default_host.description: The default host address to connect to if none is provided on the command line.

default_port.description: The default TCP port number for the TN3270 service.

font.description: The X11 font specification to use for rendering the 3270 terminal screen.

enable_tn3270e.description: Boolean flag to enable TN3270 Extended Protocol support (RFC 2355).

hosts.description: A list of host connection strings to prioritize. Each item is a string in the format 'hostname' or 'hostname:port'.
